key: MURMINA: Y-you again!?
en: MURMINA: Y-you again!?
ja: ムルミナ: ま、また あなた!?

key: How did you find me?!
en: How did you find me?!
ja: どうやって、あたしを見つけたの!?

key: This is supposed to be Caroline's secret place!
en: This is supposed to be Caroline's secret place!
ja: ここは、キャロラインの秘密の場所のはずなのに!

key: Only her closest friends knew how to get in!
en: Only her closest friends knew how to get in!
ja: ここへの入り方は、一番仲のいい友達しか知らないはずよ!

key: W-wait... Are you friends with Caroline?
en: W-wait... Are you friends with Caroline?
ja: ま、待って……あなた、キャロラインの友達なの?

key: N-no! I doubt it!
en: N-no! I doubt it!
ja: い、いいえ! そんなわけない!

key: Or are you with those Meteor assholes!?
en: Or are you with those Meteor assholes!?
ja: それとも、あのメテオのクズどもの仲間!?

key: If you really are with Caroline... then...
en: If you really are with Caroline... then...
ja: もし本当にキャロラインの知り合いなら……その時は……

key: Prove it! Show me something of hers!
en: Prove it! Show me something of hers!
ja: 証明してみせて! 彼女の持ち物を見せて!

key: Something she gave you or some kind of memento!
en: Something she gave you or some kind of memento!
ja: 彼女がくれたものとか、何か形見になるものを!

key: Only then will I believe it!
en: Only then will I believe it!
ja: それが分かれば信じるから!

key: MURMINA: That's-- That picture... It's Caroline's--
en: MURMINA: That's-- That picture... It's Caroline's--
ja: ムルミナ: それは……その写真……キャロラインの――

key: Give it to me... Please.
en: Give it to me... Please.
ja: それを、渡して……お願い。

key: \PN handed over the Family Picture.
en: \PN handed over the Family Picture.
ja: \PNは かぞくのしゃしん を手渡した。

key: MURMINA: Thank you...
en: MURMINA: Thank you...
ja: ムルミナ: ありがとう……

key: Where did you get this?
en: Where did you get this?
ja: これ、どこで手に入れたの?

key: We used to be close friends...
en: We used to be close friends...
ja: あたしたち、昔は仲のいい友達だったの……

key: I know Charlotte blamed herself... for what happened to Caroline.
en: I know Charlotte blamed herself... for what happened to Caroline.
ja: シャルロットが自分を責めてたの、知ってる……キャロラインに起きたことで。

key: But I never believed it was her fault...
en: But I never believed it was her fault...
ja: でも、あたしはあれが彼女のせいだなんて、一度も思わなかった……

key: There was a man, watching them--
en: There was a man, watching them--
ja: あの二人を見てる男がいたの――

key: Following them--
en: Following them--
ja: つけ回してた――

key: I tried to warn them...
en: I tried to warn them...
ja: 二人に警告しようとしたの……

key: I tried to stop him--
en: I tried to stop him--
ja: あの男を止めようとした――

key: But in the end-- y-you know...
en: But in the end-- y-you know...
ja: でも結局――そ、その先は知ってるでしょ……

key: Afterwards, I thought-- I might be next.
en: Afterwards, I thought-- I might be next.
ja: それから、思ったの――次はあたしの番かもしれないって。

key: It's been in the back of my head every single day ever since--
en: It's been in the back of my head every single day ever since--
ja: それ以来、毎日ずっと頭の片隅にあって――

key: When I woke up and realized Team Meteor was crawling over Agate, I bolted as fast as I could.
en: When I woke up and realized Team Meteor was crawling over Agate, I bolted as fast as I could.
ja: 目を覚まして、チームメテオがアゲートにはいずり回ってるって分かった時、あたしはできる限り速く逃げ出したの。

key: And-- you know the rest.
en: And-- you know the rest.
ja: それで――後は分かるでしょ。

key: I'm sorry for the trouble...
en: I'm sorry for the trouble...
ja: 迷惑かけて、ごめんなさい……

key: This room used to be a place for me and Caroline to...
en: This room used to be a place for me and Caroline to...
ja: この部屋は、昔あたしとキャロラインが……

key: ...Um, get away from everything.
en: ...Um, get away from everything.
ja: ……その、何もかもから逃げるための場所だったの。

key: She also made herself a private PC storage system here...
en: She also made herself a private PC storage system here...
ja: ここには、彼女が自分専用のPCボックスも作ってて……

key: I was one of the only people who had access--
en: I was one of the only people who had access--
ja: アクセスできるのは、あたしくらいのもので――

key: Actually, ah, could you excuse me?
en: Actually, ah, could you excuse me?
ja: というか、あの、ちょっと外してもらえる?

key: Here... This was from one of her old breeding projects.
en: Here... This was from one of her old breeding projects.
ja: はい……これは、彼女の昔の繁殖計画の一つだったものよ。

key: Consider it my apology for running you around.
en: Consider it my apology for running you around.
ja: 振り回してしまったおわびだと思って。

key: Please take good care of it...
en: Please take good care of it...
ja: どうか大事にしてあげて……

key: \PN got the Egg!
en: \PN got the Egg!
ja: \PNは タマゴ を手に入れた!

key: Now... could you please leave me be for a while?
en: Now... could you please leave me be for a while?
ja: それじゃ……しばらく一人にしてもらえる?

key: I'd prefer to be alone for now...
en: I'd prefer to be alone for now...
ja: 今は一人になりたいの……

key: MURMINA: Then leave!
en: MURMINA: Then leave!
ja: ムルミナ: なら出て行って!

key: Don't play with me like that-- haven't we suffered enough!?
en: Don't play with me like that-- haven't we suffered enough!?
ja: そんなふうにあたしをからかわないで――もう十分苦しんだじゃない!?

key: LEAVE!
en: LEAVE!
ja: 出て行って!

key: MURMINA: If you really are with Caroline... then...
en: MURMINA: If you really are with Caroline... then...
ja: ムルミナ: もし本当にキャロラインの知り合いなら……その時は……

key: MURMINA: Oh... Hey... Could you give me a little space please?
en: MURMINA: Oh... Hey... Could you give me a little space please?
ja: ムルミナ: あ……ねえ……少し距離を置いてもらえる?

key: Thanks...
en: Thanks...
ja: ありがとう……

key: MURMINA: Hi... Could you please leave me alone for a while?
en: MURMINA: Hi... Could you please leave me alone for a while?
ja: ムルミナ: どうも……しばらく一人にしてもらえる?

key: Thank you...
en: Thank you...
ja: ありがとう……

key: MURMINA: Nice to see you...
en: MURMINA: Nice to see you...
ja: ムルミナ: 会えてうれしいわ……

key: But I'd like some alone time please...
en: But I'd like some alone time please...
ja: でも、少し一人の時間が欲しいの……

key: -USERNAME AND PASSWORD REQUIRED-
en: -USERNAME AND PASSWORD REQUIRED-
ja: -ユーザー名とパスワードが必要です-

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
